name: Floating Action Button
description: A fixed-position primary action button for the single most important creation task on a screen.
usage:
<FloatingActionButton
  label="Create item"
  tooltip="Add a new item"
  position="bottom-right"
  onClick={createItem}
/>

anatomy.description: The round, fixed-position button named by the required label prop.
The centered glyph, a plus by default, hidden from assistive technology.
The optional hover and focus hint defaulting to the label.
The optional text that turns the round button into a labelled pill.

dos: Reserve it for the single most important creation action on a screen.
Always provide label so the icon-only button has an accessible name.
Use extendedLabel where space allows for extra clarity.
donts: Don't use it for destructive or secondary actions.
Don't show more than one floating action button per screen.
Don't let it cover primary content; pick the corner that stays clear.

examples.title: Round FAB with tooltip
examples.description: Icon-only button fixed to a viewport corner; the tooltip supplies the visible name on hover.

examples.title: Extended FAB
examples.description: An extendedLabel turns the round button into a pill with text for extra clarity.

guidance.useWhen: One creation action dominates the screen, such as composing a message or adding a record to a long list.
guidance.avoidWhen: Several actions compete or the action is destructive; use an ActionBar or regular Button instead.
guidance.behavior: Stays fixed to the chosen viewport corner while content scrolls; label always names the button for assistive tech.
guidance.responsive: Keeps a constant offset from the viewport edges at all widths; prefer the extended pill only when space allows.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to and from the button.

notes: Icon-only by default, so the required label prop provides the accessible name via aria-label.
The optional tooltip also exposes the name to sighted keyboard users on focus.

props.description: Text rendered next to the icon; turns the round FAB into an extended pill.
props.name: extendedLabel

props.description: Icon rendered inside the button. Defaults to a plus icon.
props.name: icon

props.description: Accessible name for the button; also the default tooltip text.
props.name: label

props.description: Viewport corner the button is fixed to.
props.name: position

props.description: Tooltip text shown on hover and focus; pass the label or a longer hint.
props.name: tooltip
